notes.title: Update Patch Notes Mar 03
notes.notes:
[list]
Patch Notes:

[*]Added descriptions to the three modes available before starting a new game. This clarifies the differences between the modes and make it clear that all events are accessible regardless of the chosen mode.

[*]Restored the bookstore functionality to the Nimble Finger contract. Players can now achieve 100% completion in Nimble Finger and earn the associated achievement. Additionally, purchasing the book now provides a permanent +1 boost to knowledge.

[*]Fixed a bug affecting Luna's 'Fearless Serpent' event. The first image now displays correctly as intended.

[*]Various grammar corrections and improvements have been implemented for enhanced readability and clarity.
[/list]

notes.title: Update patch notes feb 28
notes.notes:
Full experience: Lucania intro has changed so it just goes from event to event, same as with Freeroaming and Vn-mode.

Access to Lucania town has been temporarily disabled due to no content beside the intro available there. We plan to re-enable and enhance the town once new content is added. 

This [b]should[/b] resolve the Lucia-intro loop bug that some players have encountered. Unfortunately, saved games affected by this issue are no longer usable. If you've encountered this problem, please send your save file to me at hopesgaming@hotmail.com, and I'll address it as soon as possible. The save file will also aid our efforts to identify and fix the bug, as we've been unable to replicate it ourselves.

-HG
